description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Forgotten' class within the 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Mail' namespace. It defines a controller that handles the email process for password reset requests, including preparing and sending email notifications to users who have forgotten their passwords.

classes.name: Forgotten
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling password forgotten email functionality in the admin panel of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the process of sending a forgotten password email to the specified address. It verifies inputs, loads language text, prepares email content, and utilizes the Mail class to send the email.
